## Details

<a id="lantern_list_ptr"></a>
### [`lantern_list_ptr`](../../../../src/room/lantern_lists.asm#L13) `$4CE2-$4D0B`

*data*

Per-room pointer to the room's lantern list (21 words: rooms 0-19 and a spare list). Lantern list format: 4-byte records ended by $FF: +0 state: 1 = lantern present, 0 = collected (reset_all_lanterns sets all to 1 at a game start) +1 replacement cell code drawn when the lantern is collected (top = AND $7F, bottom = OR $80) +2 column (Y offset in the text line), +3 text line. check_lantern_pickup finds a present lantern at a column/line, clears its state, decrements room_lanterns_left+room and returns the replacement code; setup_room_lanterns_and_init draws the collected lanterns of the room when the room is drawn.

- **Read by:** [`swap_room_lanterns`](../game/game_setup.md#swap_room_lanterns), [`check_lantern_pickup`](lantern_pickup.md#check_lantern_pickup), [`setup_room_lanterns_and_init`](lantern_pickup.md#setup_room_lanterns_and_init), [`reset_room_lanterns`](lantern_pickup.md#reset_room_lanterns)

### [`lantern_list_room0`](../../../../src/room/lantern_lists.asm#L21) `$4D0C-$4D24`

<a id="extra_fall_pickups_left"></a>
### [`extra_fall_pickups_left`](../../../../src/room/lantern_lists.asm#L109) `$4E95-$4E96`

*variable*

Per-player count of the room 16 extra-fall pickup (index current_player): init_game_variables sets 5. Taking the pickup (collect_room16_bonus_check_y) decrements it and adds one fall; room16_init erases the pickup when the count is 0.

- **Read by:** [`$2FE2`](../../../../src/actor/touch_effects.asm#L19), [`room16_init`](room_specific_init.md#room16_init)
- **Written by:** [`init_game_variables`](../game/game_setup.md#init_game_variables), [`$2FE2`](../../../../src/actor/touch_effects.asm#L19)
